**Done.** Added a due date field to the item creation form. Here's what changed:

**Backend:**
- Modified `ItemBase` model to include optional `due_date: datetime | None` field
- `ItemCreate`, `ItemUpdate`, and `ItemPublic` now include due_date
- Created Alembic migration `a1b2c3d4e5f6_add_due_date_to_item.py` to add the column to the database
- Migration was applied successfully

**Frontend:**
- Added `due_date: z.string().optional()` to the form schema
- Added HTML5 date input field (`type="date"`) in the AddItem form
- Form converts the date string to ISO datetime format when submitting
- Regenerated client types from the updated backend OpenAPI schema

**Verification:**
- Existing fields (title, description) continue working unchanged
- Items can be created without a due date (due_date is null) — backward compatible
- Items can be created with a due date — properly stored and returned
- Frontend build succeeds with no errors
- All types compile correctly
